name: Whether a function departs from its own docstring
summary: Asks, once per documented function in the workspace, whether its code, or the way the listed call sites use it, departs from what its docstring states.

per_finding.instructions: The function in `{finding}` doesn't do what its docstring `{finding}.docstring` says, or the call sites in `{finding}.callers` break what that docstring requires of its input. Judge the docstring against `{finding}.body` and the call sites. A docstring that states an assumption the call sites don't meet counts as a departure. Wording, style, and missing detail don't count.
